onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to your local vault
onboarding.welcome.desc: Accounts, passwords and two-factor codes stay encrypted in this browser on this computer — nothing is uploaded to a server. The trade-off is that they don't follow your account: a new device, a reinstall or cleared browsing data takes them, and a forgotten master password cannot be recovered by default — an offline recovery key enrolled in advance is the exception. Give this a minute — day to day the side panel or the inline dropdown is all you need; the tour opens the panel once along the way, and one step is devoted entirely to leaving yourself a way out.
onboarding.add.title: Add your first entry
onboarding.add.desc: Enter the site, account and password, then save — or just sign in on the site and let the extension ask whether to keep it, much like Chrome's password manager. Next time you open that site the extension matches it by domain: click the key icon beside the login field and pick which account to fill, or turn on "Auto-submit login" in preferences.
onboarding.add.tip: No password worth keeping? The Generate button in the Add password dialog builds one from your length and character rules.
onboarding.sidepanel.title: Get it back out of the side panel or the inline dropdown
onboarding.sidepanel.desc: Hit the button below and the panel docks beside this tab: browse what you just saved, search it, star what you use daily. The options page has no site address of its own, so it lists the whole vault — open it on a website's login page and it narrows down to that site's accounts. Rather than switch windows, use the inline dropdown: focus a login field, click the key icon at its right edge and fill an account without leaving the page — it's the default fill mode for new installs.
onboarding.sidepanel.shortcutHint: Couldn't open it? Press {shortcut} to toggle the side panel.
onboarding.empty.title: Four ways in — pick one
onboarding.empty.desc: Add entries by hand, bulk-import a CSV file, restore an encrypted .aph backup, or let the sign-in save prompt record it for you. The import preview works out how many entries still fit and which ones get skipped.
onboarding.search.title: What you'll lean on later
onboarding.search.desc: Search understands pinyin initials, and tags plus 'favorites only' stack as filters. Select rows to retag, delete or export in bulk.
onboarding.data.title: Backups and migrations live here
onboarding.data.desc: The template, import/export, encrypted backups and the trash share this one menu. An exported .aph only opens with your master password.
onboarding.data.tip: Run an encrypted backup export again whenever the vault changes. Once it's done, the chip at the top right records your last successful backup and keeps checking whether anything is still owed.
onboarding.retreat.title: Leave yourself a way out
onboarding.retreat.desc: A forgotten master password cannot be recovered. If you set a hint, go back to the unlock screen and let it jog your memory first. Short of that, an encrypted .aph backup only works if you still remember the password it was exported with — a backup made with the forgotten password will not open. The one route that needs no prior backup is an offline recovery key: enroll it in advance, and it can reset the password and unlock the data already on this device.
onboarding.retreat.action: Enroll an offline recovery key now
onboarding.retreat.actionHint: You can also do this later: enroll any time under Security settings → Offline recovery key. Skipping now does not affect your master password or saved data.
onboarding.retreat.manageHint: A recovery key is already enrolled; review, rotate or disable it here.
onboarding.retreat.tip: The recovery key is shown in full only once, at the moment it is created, and every rotation replaces it and voids the old one — save it on the spot.
onboarding.settings.title: Tune the security policy
onboarding.settings.desc: Idle auto-lock, session validity, auto-save, site rules, cross-subdomain matching, clipboard clearing, password history, the favorite limit and more all start from this group.
onboarding.health.title: Check your vault regularly
onboarding.health.desc: Finds reused, weak, commonly breached (a near-1,000-entry offline dictionary) and long-unchanged passwords, with a 0–100 score and a per-entry to-do list. The score covers password entries only — the personal info vault isn't included, and having no 2FA is listed for information without costing points.
onboarding.personalize.title: Make it look the way you like
onboarding.personalize.desc: Six accent themes, the Chinese/English interface, the quick-fill mode (inline dropdown or side panel) and the floating button's visibility all switch here. Its position isn't a setting — drag the button to the screen edge you want and it snaps into place.
